newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end higher; uptrend seen.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end higher; uptrend seen.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates finished higher on Thursday as the central bank has shown its determination to maintain stable rates, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate was at 5.069 percent against Wednesday's 4.906 close, with the 30-day commercial paper up to 4.85-5.00 against 4.80-4.85.
Dealers expected liquidity to tighten next week after Taiwan's long Retrocession Day weekend. The money and bond markets will close on Friday and Saturday.
The government bond yields rose amid bearish sentiment, with the seven-year 83/2 government bond yield at 5.465 and seven-year 85/3 bond yield at 5.68.
